<action type="say">
Understood—if your checking account isn’t appearing in your online profile at all, that usually means one of a few things:

Common reasons it’s missing:
- You’re signed in with a different customer/profile ID than the one the checking account is linked to.
- The checking account is a joint or business account that hasn’t been added to your online banking profile yet.
- The account is very new (sometimes it takes a bit to appear) or has been closed/converted.
- There’s an access/visibility restriction on that account that only support can fix.

A couple of quick checks:
1) Are you able to see this checking account in the bank’s mobile app or website anywhere else (e.g., statements section), or is it missing everywhere?
2) Is this checking account:
   - Personal in your name only,
   - Joint, or
   - Business?

If you answer those, I can suggest the most likely next step. In parallel, the fastest way to get it fixed is usually:
- In the app/website: look for “Link/add existing accounts” or “Profile/relationships” and see if it offers to add a checking account that’s already with the bank.
- Or contact support: tell them, “My checking account isn’t showing in online banking; can you link it to this login?” and have your account number or debit card handy.

Reply with:
- Whether you see the checking account anywhere at all when you log in, and
- Whether it’s personal/joint/business,  
and I’ll walk you through exactly what to say/do next.</action>

<action type="say">
If it’s a personal checking account and it’s missing everywhere when you log in, it’s almost certainly not linked correctly to this online banking profile.

Here are the most useful next steps:

1) Double-check you’re using the right login
- If you’ve ever had another username/profile with this bank (for an old account, credit card, or mortgage), try signing in with that, or using “Forgot username” with:
  - Your SSN
  - Your debit card number for that checking account
  - Or your account number (if you have checks/statements)
- If you suddenly stopped seeing this account but used to see it under this login, skip this step and go to support below.

2) Look in the app/website for “Link existing account”
If your bank offers it, it’s usually under:
- Settings / Profile / Accounts
- “Link existing accounts” or “Add accounts from this bank”
If you see that option, follow the prompts and use:
- The checking account number and routing number, or
- The debit card number associated with that checking account.

3) Contact support to link the account
If steps 1–2 don’t fix it, support has to manually link it. When you call or start a secure chat, say something like:

- “I have a personal checking account that isn’t showing in my online banking at all. Can you link it to my current username?”
- Have ready:
  - Your full name and DOB
  - Last 4 of SSN
  - The checking account number or debit card number
  - A recent mailing address on the account

Ask them specifically to:
- Verify the checking account is open and active
- Confirm what online profile/username it’s tied to
- Link it to the username you’re currently using

4) Ways to see the balance in the meantime
While this is getting fixed, you can still:
- Check at an ATM with the debit card for that account
- Call the bank’s automated phone system (use the “account info/balances” option)
- Visit a branch and ask for your current and available balance

If you tell me:
- Whether you know your checking account number or at least have the debit card, and  
- Whether you prefer calling or using secure chat/app,  
I can draft an exact script or message you can paste to support.</action>

Here’s a short message you can paste into secure chat in your banking app:

---
Hi, I have a personal checking account that is not appearing anywhere in my online banking when I log in. 

I can use the debit card for this checking account, but the account itself doesn’t show up in my accounts list. Can you please:
1) Confirm that the checking account tied to this debit card is open and active, and  
2) Link that checking account so it appears under my current online banking username?

I have my debit card and can provide any verification details you need.
---

Have this ready in case they ask:
- The last 4 digits of the debit card
- Your full name, DOB, and last 4 of SSN
- Your mailing address

Once they link it, log out of the app, log back in, and the checking account should appear so we can then check the balance normally.

If you want, you can paste what support replies here and I’ll help you interpret it or suggest what to ask next.</action>
